email.footer: This is an automated message from FlyBot Smart Trap Studio.
email.footerAlerts: You receive alert emails because email notifications are on. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
email.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

passwordReset.subject: Reset your FlyBot password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your FlyBot password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for your account was just changed, and all other sessions were signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you did not do this, reset your password right away and contact your administrator.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for FlyBot
verifyEmail.intro: Please confirm this email address so we can send you pest alerts and account notices.

pest_threshold.subject: ⚠️ Pest alert: {count} insects at {deviceName}
pest_threshold.body: Camera {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) counted {count} insects in the latest scan, at or above your alert threshold of {threshold}.

camera_offline.subject: 📡 Camera offline: {deviceName}
camera_offline.body: Camera {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) has gone offline. Check its power supply and Wi-Fi/4G connection.

ai_failure.subject: 🤖 AI analysis failing: {deviceName}
ai_failure.body: The last {failures} snapshots from camera {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) could not be analyzed. Insect counts for this trap may be missing.

card_due.subject: 🪤 Time to replace the sticky card: {deviceName}
card_due.body: The sticky card on camera {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) has been up for {days} days. Replace it so counts stay accurate, then press "Card replaced" in FlyBot.

plot_threshold.subject: ⚠️ Plot alert: {plotName} ({farmName})
plot_threshold.body: The traps in plot {plotName} of {farmName} average {average} insects in their latest scans, at or above the plot threshold of {threshold}.

cameraShared.subject: {sharer} shared the camera {deviceName} with you
cameraShared.body: {sharer} gave you access to the trap camera {deviceName}. You can watch it and see its insect statistics in FlyBot.

invite.subject: {sharer} invited you to FlyBot
invite.body: {sharer} shared the trap camera {deviceName} with {email} on FlyBot. Create an account with this email address and confirm it to get access.

dashboardShared.subject: {sharer} shared the dashboard {dashboardName} with you
dashboardShared.body: {sharer} shared the dashboard {dashboardName} with you on FlyBot.

dashboardInvite.subject: {sharer} invited you to FlyBot
dashboardInvite.body: {sharer} shared the dashboard {dashboardName} with {email} on FlyBot. Create an account with this email address and confirm it to get access.

farmShared.subject: {sharer} shared the farm {farmName} with you
farmShared.body: {sharer} shared the farm {farmName} with you on FlyBot. You can now see its plots and traps.

farmInvite.subject: {sharer} invited you to FlyBot
farmInvite.body: {sharer} shared the farm {farmName} with {email} on FlyBot. Create an account with this email address and confirm it to get access.

telegram.welcome: Hello! To receive FlyBot alerts here, open FlyBot → Settings → Notifications and press "Connect Telegram".
telegram.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Create a new one in FlyBot → Settings → Notifications.
telegram.linked: Connected to FlyBot account {email}. Pest and camera alerts will arrive here. Send /stop to disconnect.
telegram.unlinked: Disconnected. You will no longer receive FlyBot alerts here.
telegram.notLinked: This chat is not connected to a FlyBot account.
telegram.help:
Commands:
/stop - stop receiving alerts
To connect, use "Connect Telegram" in FlyBot → Settings → Notifications.
telegram.test: ✅ Test message from FlyBot. Alerts for {email} will arrive in this chat.

push.testBody: You will get pest alerts and camera status changes on this device.
